decisions.reason: As a training programme tightly linked to the firm’s existing application know-how, service model, and customer support capabilities, it fits the firm’s absorptive capacity well and is relatively easy to refine and commercialise.

This rotary axis accessory builds directly on the firm’s installed machinery base, modular engineering, and precision-milling knowledge, so management would usually retain it unless demand proved persistently weak.

Because hybrid additive post-processing is comparatively distant from the firm’s established knowledge base, the firm is less able to interpret early market feedback and improve it efficiently despite having in-house R&D.
A high-speed CNC milling machine is close to the firm’s core technological and commercial capabilities, making it a natural candidate to keep and develop further in a growing machinery market.

The automatic tool change system complements the firm’s existing equipment portfolio and draws on its strong engineering, testing, and productivity-focused customer knowledge, which lowers the likelihood of withdrawal.
